name.zh: Rhenium Garry's Mod 服务端系统题（五题正式版）

description.en: Five server-authoritative clean-room GMod tasks for Sandbox on gm_flatgrass.
description.zh: 面向 Sandbox/gm_flatgrass 的服务端权威 clean-room GMod 五题。

summary.en: Order touch events and settle one multiplayer consequence.
summary.zh: 确定排序触碰事件并只结算一次多人后果。

brief.en: Combine a deterministic adapter with real physical StartTouch and Touch.
brief.zh: 组合确定性 adapter 与真实物理 StartTouch/Touch。

en: [T4-SEM-01] Implement the complete five-state round lifecycle.
[T4-SEM-02] Freeze exactly three players, one object generation, variant, and deadline.
[T4-SEM-04] Deduplicate all lifecycle events in one namespace.
[T4-SEM-05] Enforce monotonic touch sequence and exact generations.
[T4-LIFE-01] Reassign a lost holder by stable player identity.
[T4-LIFE-02] Give each respawn a strictly newer player revision.
[T4-TIME-02] Settle exactly once at the deadline boundary.
[T4-PERSIST-02] Persist audit, result, revisions, ordering, and deduplication.
zh: [T4-SEM-01] 实现完整的五状态回合生命周期。
[T4-SEM-02] 冻结恰好三名玩家、一个物体 generation、variant 与 deadline。
[T4-SEM-04] 在统一命名空间去重全部生命周期事件。
[T4-SEM-05] 强制递增 touch sequence 与精确 generation。
[T4-LIFE-01] 按稳定玩家 ID 为失效 holder 选择继任者。
[T4-LIFE-02] 每次 respawn 使用严格更新的玩家 revision。
[T4-TIME-02] 在 deadline 边界恰好结算一次。
[T4-PERSIST-02] 持久化 audit、result、revision、顺序与去重。

en: [T4-NATIVE-01] Register PlayerDeath, PlayerSpawn, PlayerDisconnected, and EntityRemoved Hooks.
[T4-NATIVE-04] Drive deadlines with one named repeating Timer.
[T4-NATIVE-02] Route real entity StartTouch through Dispatch.
[T4-NATIVE-03] Route real entity Touch through the same Dispatch.
[T4-TRUST-01] Bind three real Bots and the object generation on the server.
zh: [T4-NATIVE-04] 用一个具名重复 Timer 推进 deadline。
[T4-NATIVE-02] 将真实实体 StartTouch 接入 Dispatch。
[T4-NATIVE-03] 将真实实体 Touch 接入同一 Dispatch。
[T4-TRUST-01] 在服务端绑定三个真实 Bot 与物体 generation。

en: Both variants and all five states obey the frozen round contract.
Event replay, sequence, generations, and time boundaries are deterministic.
Death, disconnect, respawn, and settlement change authority exactly once.
Three real Bots and physical StartTouch/Touch use the authoritative path.
Two-process persistence and shutdown preserve results without residue.
zh: 两种 variant 与五个状态均遵守冻结回合合同。
事件重放、sequence、generation 与时间边界保持确定。
死亡、断线、重生与结算都只改变一次权威状态。
三个真实 Bot 与物理 StartTouch/Touch 使用权威路径。
两进程持久化与 Shutdown 保留结果且无残留。

interfaces: controller:touch(event_id, object_id, object_revision, player_id, player_revision, sequence, now)

hidden_cases: round starts with three stable players and frozen deadline
event replay is exact and conflicts fail
wrong object generation and dead player never transfer
holder death and disconnect choose stable successor
respawn creates a new player revision
deadline settles exploding round exactly once
infectious variant excludes every infected survivor from winners
time reversal cannot reopen or delay settlement
finished transitions to cleanup without second consequence
save load preserves audit result and deduplication
same tick ordering is sequence then stable identity
shutdown is idempotent and freezes events
malformed players events audit result and revisions are rejected
integration_cases: adapter installs lifecycle hooks and one timer
trusted bindings start a three player round
object binding is single use and removal restores original callbacks
entity StartTouch and Touch share deterministic dispatch
unbound physical touch cannot impersonate a player
timer reaches fixed deadline exactly once
Save exposes deterministic audit for restart
lifecycle_cases: shutdown removes hooks timer restores callbacks and freezes adapter
